4501 Lauren Mackenzie Drive
Killeen, TX 76549
$250,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,735 SF, MLS# 600040

Prime Location Perfection! Welcome to a charming slice of paradise, where a true sense of community thrives on just two streets. This comfortable and perfectly sized oasis offers unparalleled convenience, just minutes away from Fort Hood and West Fort Hood military base; and all essential amenities; schools, health care (hospital, urgent care, clinics), gas stations, and lifestyle spots like coffee shops, diverse restaurants, and even a donut place – all within this prime, walkable location. This beautifully appointed residence offers an inviting atmosphere and a thoughtful floor plan designed, for both, entertaining and everyday living. This home boasts soaring 10-foot ceilings throughout, creating an immediate sense of grandeur and airiness, that sets it apart from standard ceilings, and a heart-centered living room with a cozy fireplace in the spacious living area, perfect for relaxing after a long day. Step out to your private patio, a tranquil and serene backyard sanctuary overlooking a greenbelt, nature at your doorstep. This isn't just a porch, it's a destination. Imagine evenings spent here, cold drink in hand, watching the sky transform into a nightly masterpiece of color as the sun dips below the horizon. A true find for effortless living. This house is a lifestyle of comfort, community, and convenience. 
This captivating home won't last long. It's move-in ready and waiting for your personal touch, schedule your private tour today before it's gone!

2 full bath
